decisions.reason: As a prominently launched new product line with clear strategic fit to the firm's dental software base, it is likely to be kept while management allows time for uncertain early results to develop above aspiration levels.

Although less prominently presented than Product A, the education institute supports the core customer base and an established firm with some slack would typically continue it for another year unless results clearly fall short of aspirations.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured and appears more peripheral, it faces a higher risk of problemistic reallocation, but the firm would still likely keep it in the short run while evaluating its performance.
